title: 7-Hydroxyflavone Alleviates Myocardial Ischemia/Reperfusion Injury in Rats by Regulating Inflammation.
authors: Zhang, Qunhui; Peng, Yanfeng; Liu, Jiangyu; Yang, Yongjing; Hu, Zhangjie; Zhou, Yi; Ma, Jing; Zhang, Dejun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究7-羟基黄酮通过MAPK/NF-kB通路减轻心肌缺血再灌注损伤，仅含分子对接但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inflammation is the primary pathological process of myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury (MI/RI). 7-Hydroxyflavone (HF), a natural flavonoid with a variety of bioactivities, plays a crucial role in various biological processes. However, its cardioprotective effects and the underlying mechanisms of MI/RI have not been investigated. This study aimed to explore whether pretreatment with HF could attenuate MI/RI-induced inflammation in rats and investigate its potential mechanisms. The results showed that pretreatment with HF could significantly improve the anatomic data and electrocardiograph parameters, reduce the myocardial infarct size, decrease markers of myocardial injury (aspartate transaminase, creatine kinase, lactate dehydrogenase, and cardiac troponin I), inhibit inflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha), suppress oxidative stress, and recover the architecture of the cardiomyocytes. The cardioprotective effect of HF was connected with the regulation of the MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. What is more, molecular docking was carried out to prove that HF could be stably combined with p38, ERK1/2, JNK, and NF-kappaB. In summary, this is a novel study demonstrating the cardioprotective effects of HF against MI/RI in vivo. Consequently, these results demonstrate that HF can be considered a promising potential therapy for MI/RI.
abstract_zh: 炎症是心肌缺血/再灌注损伤（MI/RI）的主要病理过程。7-羟基黄酮（HF），一种具有多种生物活性的天然黄酮类化合物，在各种生物过程中发挥着关键作用。然而，其对MI/RI的心脏保护作用及潜在机制尚未被研究。本研究旨在探讨HF预处理是否能减轻大鼠MI/RI诱导的炎症，并研究其潜在机制。结果表明，HF预处理能显著改善解剖数据和心电图参数，减少心肌梗死面积，降低心肌损伤标志物（天冬氨酸转氨酶、肌酸激酶、乳酸脱氢酶和心肌肌钙蛋白I），抑制炎症细胞因子（IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α），抑制氧化应激，并恢复心肌细胞结构。HF的心脏保护作用与MAPK/NF-κB信号通路的调控有关。此外，进行了分子对接以证明HF能与p38、ERK1/2、JNK和NF-κB稳定结合。总之，这是一项新颖的研究，证明了HF在体内对MI/RI的心脏保护作用。因此，这些结果表明HF可被视为MI/RI的一种有前景的潜在治疗策略。
